item.title: HR Executive
item.shortdescription: This role is ideal for professionals with 1 to 1.5 years of experience in the Agriculture or Fertilizer industries. The selected candidate will manage end-to-end HR operations, including recruitment, performance management, and onboarding, while supporting learning and development initiatives. Key requirements include a strong grasp of labor laws, proficiency in MS Office/HR software, and excellent organizational skills to handle vendor management and documentation. This position offers the flexibility of part-time or full-time work arrangements. It is a comprehensive opportunity to oversee the entire employee lifecycle within a specialized industrial sector.
item.description:

item.title: Export Import Manager
item.shortdescription: We are seeking a detail-oriented EXIM Executive to manage export-import operations at our Pune location. The role involves handling end-to-end documentation for exports and imports, including coordination with transporters, CHA, and regulatory authorities, as well as ensuring compliance with customs laws and international trade regulations. The candidate will be responsible for shipment tracking, approvals, import/export documentation, and adherence to compliance processes such as SEEPZ, IGCR, and customs clearance. Ideal candidates should have 2 years of experience in EXIM operations with strong knowledge of documentation, compliance, and coordination in international trade.
item.description:

Location: Pune
Experience: 2 Years in Export Import
Qualification: Graduation In Export Import/BBA/B.COM

Key Responsibilities:

Managing SGS & COC documentation

Skills Required:
Strong knowledge of EXIM regulations & documentation

Excellent written & verbal communication skills
Ability to work efficiently with transporters, CHA, & regulatory bodies

Join Our Growing Team & Expand Your EXIM Career!
